notes: Target workload: enterprise media search across long-form transcripts (30k+ tokens sometimes), video captions, and legacy PDFs.
Primary KPIs: p95 query latency < 250ms (IR only), end-to-end p95 < 450ms with reranker; cost target <$0.02/query at current QPS (avg 12 qps peak 60).
Index scale expectation: 1M-5M original assets -> 3M-12M stored chunks depending on chunking strategy (overlap 20-50%).

Chunking options discussed: 1) semantic chunking by paragraph (~200-400 tokens), 2) sliding window 512-token with 128 overlap for context, 3) hybrid: paragraph for short docs + fixed-window for long transcripts.
Embeddings: prefer 1536-d dense vectors for retrieval; evaluating lower-dim 768 for cost. Considering product default vs tuned model. Need vector storage in VPC (on-prem/Private).

Reranker plan: cross-encoder reranker for top-K candidates (K=20->50). Current POC uses a medium cross-encoder (adds ~120-180ms per query in Dedicated tests), exploring batching and GPU-based reranker in Dedicated pool to hit latency SLOs.
Caching: strong interest in prefix/KV caching for repeat queries (news programs with repeated queries). TTL discussion: 24h-7d depending on freshness needs.
Cost controls: want clear unit economics — impact of candidate K and reranker model size on $/query. Redwood Optimize suggestions requested for batching thresholds and quantization profiles.
Observability: need token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, and per-query rerank delta metrics for QA team.
Security: SSO (SAML), KMS integration, retention policies for vectors (default 90d vs indefinite), audit logs required for EU residency customers.
Quote from director of search: "We need results that preserve chronology and quotes — reranker must favor verbatim passages."
Paraphrase: Customer worried about "model drift" after rolling new embedding models; asks for eval harness to compare reranker gains vs cost.
requirements_summary: Build enterprise RAG search for long-form media with deterministic latency (p95 retrieval <250ms, end-to-end with reranker <450ms), cost per query < $0.02 target at current QPS, ability to host vectors and control keys in VPC/on-prem, support for SAML/KMS/audit logs, and tooling to tune chunking + reranker K for best quality/cost tradeoff.
recent_eval_metrics: POC ingest: 1.1M assets -> 3.2M chunks (hybrid chunking), avg chunk length 420 tokens.
Retrieval + cross-encoder rerank (K=20): end-to-end p95 410ms, median 175ms.
Cost observed (embeddings + retrieval + rerank): ~$0.017/query at sample load (12 qps avg), projected $0.026/query at peak 60 qps without batching/quantization.
Relevance: +15% NDCG on editorial test-set when adding reranker vs ANN-only top-10.
